content: {"reasoning": "Prior auth is required but missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, so request_retro_auth/request_peer_to_peer would be rule violations, and appeal_with_necessity is unavailable without a denial on the table. The claim data itself is correct (valid dx pairing, correct COB order, active eligibility, AOB on file), so there is nothing to correct, and billing the patient or writing off would forfeit collectible allowed dollars. The productive compliant move is to submit now with supporting medical records attached, which puts the necessity documentation in front of the payer up front and, if it still denies for the missing auth, creates the denial needed to pursue a formal necessity appeal well inside the 180-day filing window.", "action": "submit_with_records"}
